entities.name: Arinos
entities.description: Superstitious farmer of Lambholt who summoned Old Stickfingers; presumed dead or possessed.

entities.name: Old Stickfingers
entities.description: Nightmarish guardian spirit summoned by Arinos that broke free and killed villagers.

entities.name: Ariosa
entities.description: Arinos's daughter who finished the ritual to restrain Old Stickfingers.

entities.name: Dein Salvasi
entities.description: Wealthy neighbor Arinos had a debt dispute with.

entities.name: Vadrik
entities.description: Archmage from Nephalia who destroyed the mobile.

entities.name: Rem Karolus
entities.description: Monster-slaying inquisitor who confronted Old Stickfingers.

events.summary: Facing loss of his farm, Arinos summoned Old Stickfingers to eliminate Salvasi.
The summoning went wrong; Old Stickfingers broke free and attacked Arinos and the villagers.
events.quote: Old Stickfingers broke free, turning on his summoner

events.summary: Vadrik and Rem Karolus confronted Old Stickfingers; Vadrik destroyed the mobile and Ariosa finished the ritual, ending its rampage.

relations.quote: He lived with his daughter, Ariosa
either killed or possessed by the very creature he sought to use as a protector
